evidence: A commenter recommends Ergo, citing its single binary and IRCv3 support.

evidence_sources.author: stackghost
evidence_sources.excerpt: I recommend the Ergo ircd. It ships as a single binary (golang), can support tens of thousands of clients, is at the forefront of the ircv3 modernization initiative, and is under active development.

source_story_title: Parley: Federated, decentralised chat that speaks plain IRC
